report.question: Source129 no-shooters flag, HP and EA:B records
report.method: Ordinary bounded offline PE/Pascal/ERM inspection. REA previously unavailable; no installation or runtime execution. No REA Evidence claims.

observations.finding: Only affected creatures whose base descriptor shooter mask0x4 is present enter this branch. MA:X d-4 subtracts4 arithmetically; because mask0x4 was tested set, this equals clearing that shooter bit and preserves every other bit. Does not zero NumShots or clear all ranged-related descriptor flags.

creatureInfoTablePtr +116*id+76 is descriptor HitPoints (+0x4c), signed32. Read/write size4. NewHP=truncTowardZero_signed(wrap32(oldHP*3)/2). No min1, maxHP clamp, float rounding or widened multiply in this path.

Exactly20 rows per creature; each17bytes:metadata uint32rawbits at0, ability signed8 at4, modifier unsigned8 at5, rank0..10 unsigned8 at6..16. The fourteen fields after rowindex cover all17bytes. Byte SETs truncate to low8 bits; GET signedness differs for ability versus modifier/ranks.

For source129 creature selectors>=0, EA:B SET performs the direct table update and exits. No callback/regrant or immediate combat refresh is called by this selected branch. Negative EA selectors have additional refresh paths; they are outside this source loop.

An alternate per-stack table can replace creature table; existing combat state is not immediately reset by the setter. No global ban on every possible ability source follows.

unknowns: No runtime, final plugin load order, computed patches, external mods or actual working battle state observed. Static on-disk consumers and matching supplied source are bounded evidence.

Close/distance/obstacle semantic labels originate in the supplied source129 comments and are corroborated by the specific consumers/wrappers described; native geometry tests and every callback caller are not fully reconstructed.
No conclusion on artifact bonuses, hero bonuses, spells or uninspected plugins. Clearing per-creature XP rows is not proof all independent shooter grants are suppressed.

Alternate per-stack XP records and later ERM EA:B writes, reloads or table reinitialization can supply different data. Exact lifetime, persistence, save/reload and callback timing are not established.
Immediate removal from an already active combat stack is not established: positive EA:B writes no refresh here, and MA:X changes descriptor rather than every existing stack.
On-disk EA creature selector accepts0..255 and row0..19; expanded rosters/relocation not admitted. Raw descriptor table pointer is supplied by source; no broad relocation audit.
Metadata bits besides activebit0 and every numeric modifier meaning were not fully reconstructed. Clearing all bytes is established without needing their names.
Generic flags/VR error handling and invalid syntax are not admitted. Source129 uses integer quick variableh and literal3/2, avoiding arbitrary mixed float arguments.
